def execute(filters=None):
    # Define columns
    columns = [
        {"label": "Serial No", "fieldname": "serial_number", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 80},
        {"label": "Sample ID", "fieldname": "sample_id", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Soil Sample Collection", "width": 150},
        {"label": "Target Lab", "fieldname": "target_lab", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 150},
        {"label": "Received Office", "fieldname": "received_office", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 150},
        {"label": "Collection Date", "fieldname": "collection_date", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 120},
        {"label": "Collection Program Name", "fieldname": "collection_program_name", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 200}
    ]

    # Fetch data
    # Ensure field names here match your DocType exactly
    data = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT 
            name, 
            target_lab, 
            district_office_name, 
            collection_date, 
            name_of_type 
        FROM `tabSoil Sample Collection` 
        ORDER BY name DESC
    """, as_dict=True)

    results = []
    for i, row in enumerate(data, start=1):
        results.append({
            "serial_number": i,
            "sample_id": row.name,
            "target_lab": row.target_lab,
            "received_office": row.district_office_name,
            "collection_date": row.collection_date,
            "collection_program_name": row.name_of_type
        })

    return columns, results
